title: IB May 2027 Exam Schedule: Full DP and CP Timetable
summary: See the final IB May 2027 exam schedule for DP and CP students, including every paper, duration, session, exam-zone start time and rescheduling rules.
body_markdown:
The final **IB May 2027 exam schedule** runs from **Friday 23 April to Tuesday 18 May 2027** for Diploma Programme (DP) and Career-related Programme (CP) students taking DP examinations. It applies across IB exam zones A, B and C, with local start times determined by zone.


The session opens with a pre-session afternoon on 23 April. The main examination period begins Monday 26 April and ends with Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches (AA) HL paper 3 and Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation (AI) HL paper 3 on 18 May.


### IB May 2027 exam schedule: key facts


- **First examination date:** Friday 23 April 2027
- **Main examination period:** 26 April–18 May 2027
- **Final examinations:** Mathematics AA HL and AI HL paper 3
- **Zones covered:** A, B and C
- **Language dates:** English, Spanish and French are scheduled separately
- **Rescheduling:** Requires IB approval
- **Daylight saving:** Published start times are not adjusted


In the tables, **P1, P2 and P3** mean paper 1, paper 2 and paper 3. Durations are shown as hours (h) and minutes (m). A school-based syllabus paper without a published duration is marked **not specified** .

### Language examination dates


English papers are scheduled for **6–7 May** , Spanish papers for **12–13 May** , and French papers for **17–18 May** . Other Language A courses generally run on 26–27 April, while other Language B and ab initio courses run on 4–5 May. Latin and Classical Greek have separate timetable entries.

These are local examination start times and are used consistently within each zone. The timetable says schools do **not** adjust them for daylight-saving changes. Schools may require students to arrive earlier for identification, seating and instructions, so candidates should follow their coordinator’s reporting time.


### What DP and CP students should know


DP students need only identify entries matching their registered subjects, levels and languages. Multiple papers listed in one session cover different courses and do not mean every candidate sits all listed examinations.


For CP students, the timetable applies when they are registered for externally assessed DP courses. The CP core is not listed as a separate set of common written examinations.


Schools cannot independently move an examination because of a student’s preferred schedule or a demanding sequence. Any rescheduling requires IB authorization. Students who identify an apparent clash or circumstances affecting attendance should contact their DP or CP coordinator.


The IB says the **IB exam timetable 2027** uses registration data to reduce subject clashes, generally places papers from the same subject on consecutive days, and considers regional or cultural connections. Public holidays are not generally accommodated, apart from 1 May.


Students should now check their registered subject, level, paper and language, then confirm their school’s exam zone and arrival requirements. Any registration discrepancy or apparent clash should be raised with the coordinator. Students should not copy start times from another school or online calendar because local clock times depend on the school’s assigned zone.


### May 2028 examination dates


The following May session is planned for **Tuesday 25 April to Friday 19 May 2028** , with no examinations on 1 May. These dates remain **subject to confirmation** and are not yet a final 2028 timetable.


*Source note: This article follows the final May 2027 examination schedule for all exam zones. Students and families should follow instructions issued directly by their school coordinator for registration, arrival and examination-day procedures.*
